visual_justification: GAZKUN family shows dramatic visual geometry change: GAZKUN (boundary, S_Td=0.44, flattened Td-like) → LOYZII (near-ideal Td, all angles ~109°) → TUGKOX (near-ideal SP, two trans angles ~176°). This makes the SP↔Td interconversion visually obvious in both polyhedron and first_sphere renderings.
why_not_IKEXEC: IKEXEC/MIGTEE family, despite high CShM span, shows minimal visual difference in first_sphere XYZ because all members have similar Ni-donor angles near the distorted region. GAZKUN shows actual SP↔Td pattern change with angle RMSD=42.5° vs IKEXEC's ~5°.
